card.text: Kepler-10 b was found in 2011 by Kepler as it crossed its star.

sources.label: Wikipedia, "Kepler-10b"
sources.quote: Kepler-10b is the first confirmed terrestrial planet to have been discovered outside the Solar System by the Kepler Space Telescope.

introduction.text: It is one of 3 planets known around Kepler-10. Its orbit and size follow Dumusque et al. 2014's fit, the archive's default.

sources.label: Wikipedia, "Kepler-10b"
sources.quote: Discovered after several months of data collection during the course of the NASA-directed Kepler Mission, which aims to discover Earth-like planets crossing in front of their host stars, the planet's discovery was announced on January 10, 2011.

shape.title: Shape only
shape.summary: A sphere at the published size. No picture of its surface exists.
